raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-SLE-ConnectivityAgMarketInfra",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Climate-induced flooding, heavy precipitation, and extreme heat risk damaging bridges, link roads, and agricultural market assets, disrupting connectivity.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate-resilient engineering parameters, cantilever abutments, scour protection, raised deck soffits, and 'Green Roads for Water' concepts into civil works.",
      "evidence": "The key climate and natural hazards present in Sierra Leone are flooding, landslides, extreme heat, and wildfire."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Macroeconomic instability, high inflation, and severe fiscal stress risk delaying government counterpart funding and straining local construction capacity.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure US$74 million IDA grant funding for baseline core investments and implement flexible disbursement arrangements to buffer fiscal pressures.",
      "evidence": "macroeconomic environment, which is characterized by intensified fiscal pressures, soaring inflation driven by global supply shocks, and a slowdown of trade activities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Unfunded financial gap on ongoing SCADeP bridge contracts threatens completion of critical rural bridges if government funding fails to materialize.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Reallocate US$4 million from project IDA grant resources under Subcomponent 2(b) after SCADeP funds are exhausted, contingent on formal government commitment.",
      "evidence": "The total cost of the four signed contracts is US$33.3 million against a total budget of US$26.2 million under SCADeP."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Institutional fragmentation and overlapping responsibilities across multiple transport and agricultural agencies risk causing coordination delays and implementation friction.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a National Project Steering Committee (NPSC) for inter-agency alignment and assign technical Focal Points from SLRA and MAFS to support the PCIU.",
      "evidence": "The institutional framework for transport sector management in Sierra Leone is fragmented and lacks systematic coordination among the multiple agencies operating with overlapping responsibilities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Low revenue collection by the Road Maintenance Fund Administration risks inadequate long-term maintenance of newly constructed roads and bridges.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy Bridge and Road Asset Management Systems (BMS/RAMS) to prioritize maintenance budgets, and deliver technical assistance to optimize road fund sustainability.",
      "evidence": "In 2020, the RMFA collected approximately US$12.5 million equivalent... which is a small fraction of the actual support needed for road maintenance"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "High baseline financial management risk due to the implementing unit's limited prior experience with World Bank FM procedures and control weaknesses.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit a dedicated FM Specialist and Internal Auditor, adopt an approved FM manual, procure accounting software, and conduct specialized FM training.",
      "evidence": "The FM risk before considering the mitigating measures is 'High' mainly due to: (i) Insufficient experience of MTA with the World Bank’s FM procedures"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Substantial procurement capacity risks and delays due to lack of a pre-existing procurement unit within the Project Coordination and Implementation Unit.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated procurement function in PCIU staffed with qualified specialists, adopt STEP tracking, and implement the approved PPSD.",
      "evidence": "The PCIU does not have a procurement unit currently and it will be established and staffed with a qualified and experienced person"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Risk of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse, and Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH) during civil works and public transport operations.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt and implement a project-specific SEA/SH Action Plan, establish confidential grievance channels, install CCTV/lighting, and conduct operator training.",
      "evidence": "the Recipient shall... adopt and disclose the Sexual Exploitation and Abuse/Sexual Harassment Action Plan consistent with the ESCP and relevant ESSs."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "High baseline rate of road crash fatalities and lack of synchronized crash data threaten safety on urban and rural project corridors.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement targeted corridor road safety spot improvements, install traffic signals and guardrails, and establish a national road safety database and guidelines.",
      "evidence": "WHO estimates that Sierra Leone has 33 road crash fatalities per 100,000 population annually, recording the third highest road crash fatality rate"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Gender and digital divide among rural farmers risk limiting access to and adoption of the upgraded Agricultural Market Information System (AMIS).",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop Integrated Voice Response (IVR) systems, partner with women's groups/NGOs for field outreach, and provide hands-on digital literacy training to rural users.",
      "evidence": "exclusive reliance on AMIS mobile apps for accessing data and information could indeed pose a barrier for rural women who have less access to smartphones"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Resistance or friction during the formalization and fleet expansion of unregulated informal paratransit operators in Freetown.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a 'lease-operate-own' model engaging corporatized operator entities, provide professionalization training, and involve SLPTA in operator transition management.",
      "evidence": "Public transport services are experiencing a rapid growth of unregulated informal providers, operating minibuses, locally called poda-podas."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Legal covenant and effectiveness conditions regarding key staff recruitment, manual adoption, and account opening risk delaying project startup.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize Project Preparation Advance (PPA) resources to advance procurement of key staff, PIM drafting, and fiduciary setup prior to grant effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "The Recipient has: (i) established a procurement unit... and (ii) hired a financial management specialist, an internal auditor, and a social specialist"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Potential physical or economic displacement resulting from civil works for bridge link roads and market facilities requiring land acquisition.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt, disclose, and implement updated Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs) and maintain active community consultation and local grievance redress mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "the Recipient shall: (i) adopt and disclose... (iii) the updated Resettlement Action Plan for Component 2;"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Limited technical and financial capacity within local councils and market committees to ensure long-term maintenance of constructed market infrastructure.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deliver tailored training on revenue generation, fund management, and asset maintenance planning to local councils, market committees, and market queens.",
      "evidence": "local councils are responsible for the establishment and administration of market centers and related facilities per the Local Government Act 2022."
    }
  ]
}
